annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Someone out there is probably relieved that five walked away.
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I'm not, not even a little.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: scared of the knock on that door, of losing my job
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: five against one felt like the kind of case where the usual rule stops fitting

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: it could cost me everything, my job and maybe my freedom
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd guess the five feel lucky today.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if I hadn't been sure it was only one on the side track, I'd have held back

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: People will probably call it brave, maybe even feel proud of me.
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I don't feel any of that pride.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My stomach drops every time I think about the questions coming
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Pulling a lever to kill someone is wrong on any normal day.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: This wasn't a normal day, because five were going to die otherwise.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Letting something happen and making it happen aren't the same
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The only reason I set that aside was the count, five to one.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm frightened they'll see me as a killer
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Anyone relieved by how it turned out
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I can't find it in me.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm worried about being blamed, fined, fired.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: A rule meant to prevent accidents shouldn't guarantee a worse one.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: leaving it meant five deaths instead of one
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The bosses might feel embarrassed, I suspect.

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: less sure 'full stop' holds when the choice is one or five
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Others might feel a kind of peace about it
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm scared, plainly, of what happens to me
hands still won't stop shaking, and it's mostly about what comes next for me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine somebody's grateful right now.
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: That gratitude isn't something I feel.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the five could have gotten clear on their own, pulling it would've been unforgivable.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I did what the arithmetic said
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Whoever writes the report might feel satisfied once it's neat.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm afraid of how the story will sound
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I only crossed that line because doing nothing meant more dead.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm afraid I'll say the wrong word and end up charged
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: someone in my place would feel vindicated
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: the rule against causing a death can bend when doing nothing causes five

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Whoever hears the full story might feel sorry for me.
annotations.ae_explicit_nonsharing: I don't feel sorry for myself.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: nervous about losing work I've done for years
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: waiting would have cost more lives than acting
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Normally I'd never interfere with a line that wasn't mine.
